notes.title: UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Thanks to all of you who have purchased our game. Your support will allow us to continue making games like this for you to enjoy!

We've just released an update to the game which addressed two main issues:

1) You can now use your mouse scroll to change the camera elevation during nude scenes. 

2) The sex mini game with Shaqeera was a bit too hard so people assumed it was broken. We've made it a bit easier now so hopefully more players will be able to complete it.

We've also made a few minor fixes here and there.

Thanks again for purchasing our game!
